Class CircuitBreakerRetry.Circuit

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.retry.intercept.CircuitBreakerRetry.Circuit
Enclosing class:
CircuitBreakerRetry
@Internal public static final class CircuitBreakerRetry.Circuit extends Object
The state of a circuit: closed, open or half-open, with the error that opened it. Several CircuitBreakerRetry states can share one, e.g. the users of a named circuit breaker, see CircuitBreakerRegistry.

Without a window, the circuit behaves as the circuit breaker of Micronaut always did. With one, the outcomes of the last calls decide, see CircuitBreakerWindow; every change of its state happens under the lock of the circuit, and every change starts a new generation, so that the outcome of a call that took a permit of an older state never counts. A half-open circuit whose trial permits have all been taken for longer than the reset timeout, e.g. by calls that never report an outcome, gives new trial permits.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher

    • acquire

      public long acquire(boolean throwWrappedException)
      Take a permit for a call of a circuit with a window: always in a closed circuit, one of the trial permits in a half-open one. The call reports its outcome with recordOutcome(long, Throwable, boolean, CircuitBreakerRetry, RetryState), or returns the permit with release(long).
      Parameters:
      throwWrappedException - Whether the error of an open circuit is wrapped
      Returns:
      The generation of the permit
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - the failure that opened the circuit, or a CircuitOpenException

    • release

      public void release(long permit)
      Return the permit of a call that ended without an outcome, e.g. cancelled: a trial permit of a half-open circuit can be taken again.
      Parameters:
      permit - The generation of the permit

      public void recordOutcome(long permit, @Nullable Throwable cause, boolean failure, CircuitBreakerRetry owner, RetryState retryState)
      Record the outcome of a call of a circuit with a window.
      Parameters:
